ei.subject: 영어

fullPassage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). As AI gains momentum and replaces people in jobs at every level, predictions are, there will be a premium placed on people who have high ability in EI. The emotional messages people send and respond to while interacting are, at this point, far beyond the ability of AI programs to mimic. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that sensing and managing emotions will remain one type of intelligence that puzzles AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are safe from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks bumps up against the impossibility of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.

questions.passage: Perhaps, the (A)[advent / decline] of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). As AI gains momentum and (B)[replaces / retains] people in jobs at every level, predictions are, there will be a (C)[premium / penalty] placed on people who have high ability in EI. The emotional messages people send and respond to while interacting are, at this point, far beyond the ability of AI programs to mimic. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that sensing and managing emotions will remain one type of intelligence that puzzles AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are safe from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks bumps up against the impossibility of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 직장에서 AI의 도래는 감성 지능에 좋은 징조이며, AI가 사람들을 대체하면서 EI 능력이 높은 사람에게 프리미엄이 부여된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① decline — replaces — premium (A 반대: 도래→쇠퇴)
❌ ② advent — retains — premium (B 반대: 대체하다→유지하다)
❌ ③ advent — replaces — penalty (C 반대: 프리미엄→벌칙)
✅ ④ advent — replaces — premium — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). As AI gains momentum and replaces people in jobs at every level, predictions are, there will be a premium placed on people who have high ability in EI. The emotional messages people send and (A)[respond / ignore] to while interacting are, at this point, far (B)[beyond / within] the ability of AI programs to (C)[mimic / create]. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that sensing and managing emotions will remain one type of intelligence that puzzles AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are safe from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks bumps up against the impossibility of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 사람들이 소통하면서 보내고 반응하는 감정적 메시지는 AI 프로그램이 모방할 수 있는 능력을 훨씬 넘어선다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① respond — beyond — mimic — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② ignore — beyond — mimic (A 반대: 반응하다→무시하다)
❌ ③ respond — within — mimic (B 반대: 넘어서→이내에)
❌ ④ respond — beyond — create (C 반대: 모방하다→창조하다)

questions.passage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). The emotional messages people send and respond to while interacting are, at this point, far beyond the ability of AI programs to mimic. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that (A)[sensing / neglecting] and managing emotions will remain one type of intelligence that (B)[puzzles / assists] AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are (C)[safe / vulnerable] from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks bumps up against the impossibility of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 감정을 감지하고 관리하는 것은 AI를 당혹시키는 한 유형의 지능으로 남을 것이며, EI 관련 직업은 기계에 빼앗기지 않고 안전하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① neglecting — puzzles — safe (A 반대: 감지하다→무시하다)
✅ ② sensing — puzzles — safe — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ sensing — assists — safe (B 반대: 당혹시키다→돕다)
❌ ④ sensing — puzzles — vulnerable (C 반대: 안전한→취약한)

questions.passage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may ①<u>bode well</u> for Emotional Intelligence (EI). As AI gains ②<u>momentum</u> and replaces people in jobs at every level, predictions are, there will be a premium placed on people who have high ability in EI. The emotional messages people send and respond to while interacting are, at this point, far ③<u>within</u> the ability of AI programs to mimic. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that sensing and ④<u>managing</u> emotions will remain one type of intelligence that puzzles AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are safe from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks bumps up against the impossibility of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 감정적 메시지는 AI의 모방 능력 '이내(within)'가 아니라 '넘어서(beyond)' 있다는 것이 문맥상 적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① bode well — 좋은 징조이다, 원문 일치
❌ ② momentum — 추진력, 원문 일치
✅ ③ within — 원문은 beyond(넘어서). AI의 능력 범위를 '넘어선다'는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ④ managing — 관리하다, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). As AI gains momentum and replaces people in jobs at every level, predictions are, there will be a premium placed on people who have high ability in EI. The emotional messages people send and respond to while interacting are, at this point, far beyond the ability of AI programs to mimic. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that sensing and managing emotions will remain one type of intelligence that puzzles AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are ①<u>endangered</u> from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of ②<u>routine</u> tasks bumps up against the ③<u>impossibility</u> of creating effective AI for activities that ④<u>require</u> emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: EI 관련 직업은 기계에 의해 '위험에 처한(endangered)'이 아니라 '안전한(safe)' 것이 문맥상 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① endangered — 원문은 safe(안전한). EI 직업이 기계에 빼앗기지 않는다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② routine — 일상적인, 원문 일치
❌ ③ impossibility — 불가능성, 원문 일치
❌ ④ require — 요구하다, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '비효과적인(ineffective)' AI가 아니라 '효과적인(effective)' AI를 만드는 것이 불가능하다는 맥락이 옳다.

❌ ② interacting — 상호작용하다, 원문 일치
❌ ③ remain — 남다, 원문 일치
✅ ④ ineffective — 원문은 effective(효과적인). 감정적 활동에 '효과적인' AI를 만드는 것이 불가능 ←정답

In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks bumps up against the impossibility of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: EI와 관련된 사람들과 직업은 ___로부터 안전하다는 의미이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① taken over by machines — 기계에 의해 대체되는 것 ←정답
❌ ② far beyond the ability — 능력을 훨씬 넘어서(문맥 부적합)
❌ ③ placed on people who — 사람들에게 부여된(문맥 부적합)
❌ ④ one type of intelligence — 한 유형의 지능(문맥 부적합)
det.tip: safe from being taken over by machines = 기계에 의해 대체되는 것으로부터 안전한

questions.passage: Perhaps, the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the workplace may bode well for Emotional Intelligence (EI). As AI gains momentum and replaces people in jobs at every level, predictions are, there will be a premium placed on people who have high ability in EI. The emotional messages people send and respond to while interacting are, at this point, far beyond the ability of AI programs to mimic. As we get further into the age of the smart machine, it is likely that sensing and managing emotions will remain one type of intelligence that puzzles AI. This means people and jobs involving EI are safe from being taken over by machines. In a survey, almost three out of four executives see EI as a “must-have” skill for the workplace in the future as the automatizing of routine tasks __________ of creating effective AI for activities that require emotional skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 일상적 업무의 자동화가 감정적 기술을 요구하는 활동에 효과적인 AI를 만드는 ___에 부딪힌다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① gains momentum in the workplace — 직장에서 추진력을 얻다(문맥 부적합)
❌ ② respond to while interacting — 상호작용하며 반응하다(문맥 부적합)
✅ ③ bumps up against the impossibility — 불가능성에 부딪히다 ←정답
❌ ④ remain one type of intelligence — 한 유형의 지능으로 남다(문맥 부적합)
